01 / THE BRIEF

Campaign objective

The campaign aimed to build buzz around Space Seven Fitness and increase brand visibility through engaging creator content, with a focus on generating strong viewership.

02 / THE EXECUTION

Our role

03 / THE THINKING

Creator selection strategy

We prioritised creators whose audiences were concentrated in Mohali and Chandigarh. We then assessed content relevance, average views and engagement.
